mapper.insert: INSERT INTO qa_rule (id, tenant_code, rule_name, rule_type, rule_content, weight, is_enabled, create_time, update_time, creator, editor, is_deleted) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantCode}, #{ruleName}, #{ruleType}, #{ruleContent}, #{weight}, #{isEnabled}, COALESCE(#{createTime}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), COALESCE(#{updateTime}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), #{creator}, #{editor}, FALSE) ON CONFLICT (tenant_code, rule_name) WHERE is_deleted = FALSE DO NOTHING
